list.name: scope
list.label: Phạm vi
list.query: Video hoàn tất : completed,Tất cả video : all

list.name: video
list.label: Video
list.query: SELECT video_ref FROM telemetry_video_metrics ORDER BY last_run_at DESC
list.definition: SELECT video_ref FROM telemetry_video_metrics ORDER BY last_run_at DESC

panels.title: Video đo đủ chi phí
panels.description: Video có mọi run tính phí được đều có chi phí (không run nào 'không đo'). Chi phí TB chỉ tính các video này.

targets.rawSql: WITH v AS (SELECT * FROM telemetry_video_metrics WHERE video_ref IN ($video) AND ('${scope}' = 'all' OR completed) AND $__timeFilter(last_run_at)) SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE cost_complete) || ' / ' || count(*) AS v FROM v

panels.title: Chi phí TB / video
panels.description: Trung bình trên các video đo đủ. Video còn run không đo bị loại khỏi trung bình, không tính thành 0.

targets.rawSql: WITH v AS (SELECT * FROM telemetry_video_metrics WHERE video_ref IN ($video) AND ('${scope}' = 'all' OR completed) AND $__timeFilter(last_run_at)) SELECT avg(cost_usd) FILTER (WHERE cost_complete) AS v FROM v

panels.title: Thời gian máy TB / video
panels.description: Tổng thời lượng run của một video; video chưa có run nào kết thúc không tính.

targets.rawSql: WITH v AS (SELECT * FROM telemetry_video_metrics WHERE video_ref IN ($video) AND ('${scope}' = 'all' OR completed) AND $__timeFilter(last_run_at)) SELECT avg(active_s) AS v FROM v

panels.title: Lead time TB / video
panels.description: Run đầu tiên → run cuối cùng đã kết thúc, gồm cả thời gian chờ duyệt.

targets.rawSql: WITH v AS (SELECT * FROM telemetry_video_metrics WHERE video_ref IN ($video) AND ('${scope}' = 'all' OR completed) AND $__timeFilter(last_run_at)) SELECT avg(lead_time_s) AS v FROM v

panels.title: Token TB / video
panels.description: Input mới + cached + output (Codex/Claude đã quy đổi). Video không dùng LLM không tính.

targets.rawSql: WITH v AS (SELECT * FROM telemetry_video_metrics WHERE video_ref IN ($video) AND ('${scope}' = 'all' OR completed) AND $__timeFilter(last_run_at)) SELECT avg(total_tokens) AS v FROM v

panels.title: Chi phí do làm lại
panels.description: Phần chi phí của các lượt chạy lại sau feedback/QA/retry, trên các video đo đủ.

targets.rawSql: WITH v AS (SELECT * FROM telemetry_video_metrics WHERE video_ref IN ($video) AND ('${scope}' = 'all' OR completed) AND $__timeFilter(last_run_at)) SELECT sum(rework_cost_usd) FILTER (WHERE cost_complete) / nullif(sum(cost_usd) FILTER (WHERE cost_complete), 0) AS v FROM v

panels.title: Token TB / video theo phase
panels.description: Trung bình trên các video có đo token ở phase đó; phase không dùng LLM để trống.

targets.rawSql: WITH v AS (SELECT * FROM telemetry_video_metrics WHERE video_ref IN ($video) AND ('${scope}' = 'all' OR completed) AND $__timeFilter(last_run_at)) SELECT p.phase, min(p.phase_order) AS ord, avg(p.fresh_input_tokens) AS "Input mới", avg(p.cached_input_tokens) AS "Cached input", avg(p.output_tokens) AS "Output" FROM telemetry_video_phase_metrics p JOIN v USING (video_ref) WHERE p.phase <> 'setup' GROUP BY p.phase ORDER BY ord

panels.title: Thời gian máy TB / video theo phase
panels.description: Trung bình trên các video có run đã kết thúc ở phase đó.

targets.rawSql: WITH v AS (SELECT * FROM telemetry_video_metrics WHERE video_ref IN ($video) AND ('${scope}' = 'all' OR completed) AND $__timeFilter(last_run_at)) SELECT p.phase, min(p.phase_order) AS ord, avg(p.active_s) AS "Thời gian máy" FROM telemetry_video_phase_metrics p JOIN v USING (video_ref) WHERE p.phase <> 'setup' GROUP BY p.phase ORDER BY ord

panels.title: Chi phí TB / video theo phase
panels.description: Trung bình trên các video đo đủ chi phí phase đó. Phase miễn phí hoặc không đo để trống.

targets.rawSql: WITH v AS (SELECT * FROM telemetry_video_metrics WHERE video_ref IN ($video) AND ('${scope}' = 'all' OR completed) AND $__timeFilter(last_run_at)) SELECT p.phase, min(p.phase_order) AS ord, avg(p.cost_usd) AS "Chi phí" FROM telemetry_video_phase_metrics p JOIN v USING (video_ref) WHERE p.phase <> 'setup' GROUP BY p.phase ORDER BY ord

panels.title: Chi phí TB / video theo nhà cung cấp
panels.description: LLM (codex, claude…) và giọng nói (elevenlabs…) trên cùng thước đo; trung bình trên các video có chi phí từ nhà cung cấp đó. Kaggle/local miễn phí nên trống.

targets.rawSql: WITH v AS (SELECT * FROM telemetry_video_metrics WHERE video_ref IN ($video) AND ('${scope}' = 'all' OR completed) AND $__timeFilter(last_run_at)) SELECT provider AS "Nhà cung cấp", avg(cost) AS "Chi phí" FROM (SELECT r.video_ref, r.provider, sum(r.cost_usd) AS cost FROM telemetry_runs r JOIN v USING (video_ref) WHERE r.has_billable GROUP BY 1, 2) t GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Chi phí giọng nói TB / video
panels.description: ElevenLabs theo giá gói (STUDIO_ELEVENLABS_USD_PER_1K_CREDITS). Kaggle/local miễn phí: không tính vào trung bình.

targets.rawSql: WITH v AS (SELECT * FROM telemetry_video_metrics WHERE video_ref IN ($video) AND ('${scope}' = 'all' OR completed) AND $__timeFilter(last_run_at)) SELECT avg(voice_cost_usd) AS v FROM v

panels.title: Credit ElevenLabs TB / video
panels.description: Credit tài khoản ElevenLabs bị trừ thật (bộ đếm trước/sau lượt tạo giọng).

targets.rawSql: WITH v AS (SELECT * FROM telemetry_video_metrics WHERE video_ref IN ($video) AND ('${scope}' = 'all' OR completed) AND $__timeFilter(last_run_at)) SELECT avg(credits) AS v FROM v

panels.title: GPU Kaggle TB / video
panels.description: Thời gian kernel T4 trên Kaggle (quota miễn phí theo tuần).

targets.rawSql: WITH v AS (SELECT * FROM telemetry_video_metrics WHERE video_ref IN ($video) AND ('${scope}' = 'all' OR completed) AND $__timeFilter(last_run_at)) SELECT avg(gpu_seconds) AS v FROM v

panels.title: Chi tiết theo phase
panels.description: Mọi trung bình bỏ qua video không đo phase đó; cột 'Video đo được' cho biết trung bình dựa trên bao nhiêu video.

targets.rawSql:
WITH v AS (SELECT * FROM telemetry_video_metrics WHERE video_ref IN ($video) AND ('${scope}' = 'all' OR completed) AND $__timeFilter(last_run_at)) SELECT p.phase AS "Phase",
  count(p.cost_usd) || ' / ' || count(*) AS "Video đo được chi phí",
  round(avg(p.runs), 2) AS "Run / video",
  round(avg(p.rework_runs), 2) AS "Làm lại / video",
  sum(p.failed_runs)::numeric / nullif(sum(p.runs), 0) AS "Tỉ lệ lỗi",
  avg(p.active_s) AS "Thời gian TB",
  avg(p.total_tokens) AS "Token TB",
  avg(p.cost_usd) AS "Chi phí TB"
FROM telemetry_video_phase_metrics p JOIN v USING (video_ref)
WHERE p.phase <> 'setup' GROUP BY p.phase, p.phase_order ORDER BY p.phase_order

panels.title: Chi phí từng video · theo phase
panels.description: Mỗi thanh một mã video (mới nhất ở trên). Phase không đo để trống, không vẽ 0.

targets.rawSql: WITH v AS (SELECT * FROM telemetry_video_metrics WHERE video_ref IN ($video) AND ('${scope}' = 'all' OR completed) AND $__timeFilter(last_run_at)) SELECT v.video_ref AS video, max(v.last_run_at) AS last, sum(p.cost_usd) FILTER (WHERE p.phase = 'script') AS "script", sum(p.cost_usd) FILTER (WHERE p.phase = 'cues') AS "cues", sum(p.cost_usd) FILTER (WHERE p.phase = 'voice') AS "voice", sum(p.cost_usd) FILTER (WHERE p.phase = 'scenes') AS "scenes", sum(p.cost_usd) FILTER (WHERE p.phase = 'render') AS "render", sum(p.cost_usd) FILTER (WHERE p.phase = 'deliver') AS "deliver", sum(p.cost_usd) FILTER (WHERE p.phase = 'other') AS "other" FROM v JOIN telemetry_video_phase_metrics p USING (video_ref) WHERE p.phase <> 'setup' GROUP BY v.video_ref ORDER BY last DESC

panels.title: Token từng video · theo phase
panels.description: Tổng token từng mã video, chia theo phase.

targets.rawSql: WITH v AS (SELECT * FROM telemetry_video_metrics WHERE video_ref IN ($video) AND ('${scope}' = 'all' OR completed) AND $__timeFilter(last_run_at)) SELECT v.video_ref AS video, max(v.last_run_at) AS last, sum(p.total_tokens) FILTER (WHERE p.phase = 'script') AS "script", sum(p.total_tokens) FILTER (WHERE p.phase = 'cues') AS "cues", sum(p.total_tokens) FILTER (WHERE p.phase = 'voice') AS "voice", sum(p.total_tokens) FILTER (WHERE p.phase = 'scenes') AS "scenes", sum(p.total_tokens) FILTER (WHERE p.phase = 'render') AS "render", sum(p.total_tokens) FILTER (WHERE p.phase = 'deliver') AS "deliver", sum(p.total_tokens) FILTER (WHERE p.phase = 'other') AS "other" FROM v JOIN telemetry_video_phase_metrics p USING (video_ref) WHERE p.phase <> 'setup' GROUP BY v.video_ref ORDER BY last DESC

panels.title: Thời gian máy từng video · theo phase
panels.description: Tổng thời lượng run từng mã video, chia theo phase.

targets.rawSql: WITH v AS (SELECT * FROM telemetry_video_metrics WHERE video_ref IN ($video) AND ('${scope}' = 'all' OR completed) AND $__timeFilter(last_run_at)) SELECT v.video_ref AS video, max(v.last_run_at) AS last, sum(p.active_s) FILTER (WHERE p.phase = 'script') AS "script", sum(p.active_s) FILTER (WHERE p.phase = 'cues') AS "cues", sum(p.active_s) FILTER (WHERE p.phase = 'voice') AS "voice", sum(p.active_s) FILTER (WHERE p.phase = 'scenes') AS "scenes", sum(p.active_s) FILTER (WHERE p.phase = 'render') AS "render", sum(p.active_s) FILTER (WHERE p.phase = 'deliver') AS "deliver", sum(p.active_s) FILTER (WHERE p.phase = 'other') AS "other" FROM v JOIN telemetry_video_phase_metrics p USING (video_ref) WHERE p.phase <> 'setup' GROUP BY v.video_ref ORDER BY last DESC

panels.title: Chi phí theo ngày · theo phase
panels.description: Chi phí đo được, gom theo ngày kết thúc run.

targets.rawSql: WITH v AS (SELECT * FROM telemetry_video_metrics WHERE video_ref IN ($video) AND ('${scope}' = 'all' OR completed) AND $__timeFilter(last_run_at)) SELECT date_trunc('day', coalesce(p.finished_at, p.started_at)) AS time, sum(p.cost_usd) FILTER (WHERE p.phase = 'script') AS "script", sum(p.cost_usd) FILTER (WHERE p.phase = 'cues') AS "cues", sum(p.cost_usd) FILTER (WHERE p.phase = 'voice') AS "voice", sum(p.cost_usd) FILTER (WHERE p.phase = 'scenes') AS "scenes", sum(p.cost_usd) FILTER (WHERE p.phase = 'render') AS "render", sum(p.cost_usd) FILTER (WHERE p.phase = 'deliver') AS "deliver", sum(p.cost_usd) FILTER (WHERE p.phase = 'other') AS "other" FROM telemetry_runs p JOIN v USING (video_ref) WHERE p.phase <> 'setup' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Theo video · mã video
panels.description: Mỗi dòng một mã video. 'không đo' = không có số liệu, khác với 0. Thanh trong ô so độ lớn giữa các video.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT video_ref AS "Video", cost_usd AS "Chi phí", total_tokens AS "Token", active_s AS "Thời gian máy",
  CASE WHEN cost_complete THEN 'đủ' WHEN billable_runs = 0 THEN 'không có run tính phí' ELSE 'thiếu ' || unmeasured_runs || ' run' END AS "Đo chi phí",
  versions AS "Phiên bản", rework_runs AS "Lượt làm lại", rework_cost_usd AS "Chi phí làm lại",
  characters AS "Ký tự TTS", credits AS "Credit TTS", gpu_seconds AS "GPU Kaggle",
  lead_time_s AS "Lead time", runs AS "Run", failed_runs AS "Lỗi", completed AS "Hoàn tất", last_run_at AS "Chạy cuối"
FROM telemetry_video_metrics WHERE video_ref IN ($video) AND ('${scope}' = 'all' OR completed) AND $__timeFilter(last_run_at) ORDER BY last_run_at DESC

panels.title: Phiên bản & làm lại
panels.description: v1 là mọi thứ tới lần render thành công đầu tiên; mỗi lần render thành công sau đó mở phiên bản mới. Lượt làm lại = chạy lại stage do feedback, QA hoặc retry.

targets.rawSql:
WITH v AS (SELECT * FROM telemetry_video_metrics WHERE video_ref IN ($video) AND ('${scope}' = 'all' OR completed) AND $__timeFilter(last_run_at)) SELECT m.video_ref AS "Video", 'v' || m.version AS "Phiên bản", m.delivered AS "Đã render",
  m.runs AS "Run", m.rework_runs AS "Lượt làm lại", m.feedback_rounds AS "Vòng feedback/QA",
  m.cost_usd AS "Chi phí", m.total_tokens AS "Token", m.active_s AS "Thời gian máy", m.started_at AS "Bắt đầu", m.finished_at AS "Kết thúc"
FROM telemetry_version_metrics m JOIN v USING (video_ref) ORDER BY m.video_ref, m.version DESC

panels.title: Truy vết feedback / QA → lượt AI
panels.description: Mỗi feedback (người duyệt hoặc QA) nối về lượt agent cuối cùng của đúng phase trước khi có feedback: agent/model, session để resume, hash prompt, có log AI (opt-in) hay không; và các lượt đã nhận sửa. Nội dung góp ý xem ở Studio theo mã feedback.

targets.rawSql:
WITH v AS (SELECT * FROM telemetry_video_metrics WHERE video_ref IN ($video) AND ('${scope}' = 'all' OR completed) AND $__timeFilter(last_run_at)) SELECT t.video_ref AS "Video", t.feedback_id AS "Feedback", t.stage AS "Stage", t.scope AS "Cảnh",
  t.code AS "Mã lỗi", t.severity AS "Mức", t.source || coalesce(' · ' || t.qa_provider, '') AS "Nguồn", t.status AS "Trạng thái",
  t.recurrence AS "Lặp", t.culprit_stage || ' #' || t.culprit_attempt || ' · v' || t.culprit_version AS "Lượt tạo ra",
  t.culprit_provider || coalesce(' · ' || t.culprit_model, '') AS "Agent", t.culprit_session AS "Session", t.culprit_prompt AS "Prompt",
  t.culprit_ai_log AS "Log AI", t.fix_attempts AS "Đã sửa bởi", t.fix_cost_usd AS "Chi phí sửa", t.created_at AS "Ghi nhận"
FROM telemetry_feedback_trace t JOIN v USING (video_ref) ORDER BY t.created_at DESC

panels.title: Chi phí theo nguồn (provenance)
panels.description: paid = có số tiền · free = miễn phí (no_charge) · unmeasured = tính phí được nhưng không đo.

targets.rawSql:
WITH v AS (SELECT * FROM telemetry_video_metrics WHERE video_ref IN ($video) AND ('${scope}' = 'all' OR completed) AND $__timeFilter(last_run_at)) SELECT r.video_ref AS "Video", r.cost_state AS "Trạng thái", coalesce(r.cost_source, '—') AS "Nguồn",
  count(*) AS "Run", sum(r.cost_usd) AS "Chi phí"
FROM telemetry_runs r JOIN v USING (video_ref) WHERE r.has_billable GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 1, 2
